fieldData.description: To celebrate the 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, the Toronto, Canada community is organising its first meetup event, with many more to come! Make sure to stop by and have a casual chat about crypto, DeFi, and RadixDLT. It’ll be a fun, welcoming event with free food and drinks. If you have any inquiries, feel free to message @jontybyl on Telegram for any questions.
fieldData.location: Jack Astor's Bar & Grill Yonge & Bloor 2 Bloor Street East Toronto, ON M4W 1A8 Canada
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meetup - Toronto
